{{Quote|Yes, madam, but I regret&mdash;they are too close to Crseih Station. The star system is most violent. The black hole, its quantum crystal companion&mdash;their influence blocks communication.|Chamberlain Iyon|<ref name="TCS" />}}
A '''[[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Crseih system/Legends|Crseih system]]. It was formed from the remains of the [[Star/Legends|star's]] core, a [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] [[supergiant]] that was destroyed by the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="TCS" />
